job.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated enlarged reference of an EMPTY CLIP HOLDER for image-to-3D modeling.
The first image is the user's authoritative close-up of the real part; second is supporting original photo context. The user explicitly corrects the interpretation: the clip is a SEPARATE INSERT and is NOT present in this photo. What is visible is ONLY its printed holder with a rectangular hole. No projecting peg/receiving pin system should appear.
Generate ONE close-up studio render showing only this empty white printed clip-holder, integral with a small patch of its gently curved/sloped inner lampshade wall. Faithfully trace the visible holder in the zoom photo: a small squat rectangular raised mounting pad/frame, slightly softened and subtly tapered edges following the slope of the wall, and one horizontal rectangular EMPTY aperture within it. Reproduce its simple raised surround and short raised upper edge as mounting material, with the aperture clearly empty and recessed under that edge. Keep the gap between the frame and the underlying shell visible where it can be seen in the source. Match the actual relative width/height/projection and orientation in the close-up, with the underlying smooth white inner shell and a small portion of its upper rim for context.
Critical negative constraints: absolutely NO clip inserted, no spring arm, no cantilever tongue crossing the aperture, no hook, no barb, no latch blade, no pin, no round receiving hole, no hinge, no brown frame or legs, no separate hardware, no screw and no extra mechanism. Do NOT fill or obstruct the rectangular opening. Do NOT render the holder as a separate loose clip. Its mounting base remains part of the small curved shell patch. The remaining shell may be cleanly cropped outside that patch; don't model the whole lamp.
Composition: one large single three-quarter macro view, similar to the supplied zoom photo, whole holder fully visible with margin and enough inner wall around it to understand attachment. Plain neutral light gray background, matte off-white finely textured 3D printed plastic, soft directional studio light that makes the opening and frame depth legible, crisp focused edges. No text, labels, dimensions, arrows, watermark, hands, printer, room, or table. This is a visual reconstruction of the observed EMPTY HOLDER, not a new connector design.
